card.name: Hands-on steps in preparation instructions
card.fires_on: Step-number periods, and words right before a handling verb or object, in instructions for preparing or using a syringe, needle cap, vial or film. It marks the point where a physical action is about to be described.

modes.label: Step number period
modes.description: The period after a step number or letter that starts a new instruction about removing or opening something.

modes.label: Before a handling phrase
modes.description: A word in the middle of a sentence about holding, removing or placing a device part, just before the action or object.
modes.example: Hold the<< needle>> cap with one hand and the syringe

modes.label: After the cap or needle phrase
modes.description: The word "by" after removing a cap, leading into how to pull or twist it.
modes.example: Remove the plastic needle cap<< by>> pulling it straight off.

card.writes: It seems to push toward hand and wrist words and physical action terms such as tightened, as in handing over or gripping.
card.plain: It fires in step-by-step directions where the reader is told to use their hands to remove, twist or place part of a device.
